_notes.encoding: Same 7-value scheme as poplar_b4t_2car/poplar_b5d_2car (170/100/130/75/220/0/255), not the Devin-standard scheme used by poplar_1/poplar_b4f_3gil
_notes.value_100_130: Adaxial_Epidermis (100, top band) + Abaxial_Epidermis (130, bottom band) → Epidermis (class 1)
_notes.value_75_220: Bundle_Sheath (75, outer ring around a vein) + Vascular_Tissue (220, inner core of a vein) → Vascular_Region (class 2)
_notes.mask_check: Verified all 24 mask slices, mode L. Union of pixel values = {0, 75, 100, 130, 170, 220, 255}; some individual slices lack 75 (no vein visible in that cross-section), which is expected
_notes.facility_beamline: Canadian Light Source, Biomedical Imaging and Therapy - Bending Magnet (BMIT-BM 05B1)
_notes.detector: PCO Edge 5.5 sCMOS with LSO:Tb scintillator (10 um)
